Before this change such a run was counted under its own call's task (its PreToolUse line is filed by event_log_hooks TASK / own_step, as the block itself says), so the task is knowable and the rule is not physically impossible. D11: 'Every session and agent's run counts'. The GM's approval (request.md, 2026-11-19): 'let's make sure all of the enforcement is real enforcement and not just instructions'. Resting the count on 'the closing step's form carries T=' makes the count depend on instructions. The mechanism also does worse than 'may go uncounted': the counter counts a launch line under the task it is filed under. A line filed under the chain's task (the block measured Phase lines naming only other tasks after 198 of 464 calls) adds to ANOTHER task's count, which can refuse that task's correct third start, the very defect T286 fixes. The 2026-11-27 measurement shows a backgrounded closing call gets its end line at launch (405 of 492, all PostToolUse with a bg id), so the old pairing test could not tell a dead start from a run. Counting by a line written only once static starts carries out D11's own test (ran). decisions.summary: A closing-checks call with no T= of its own (or one the TASK pattern does not read) writes no launch line and is still counted by its own call, under the task its own line is filed under, as on HEAD. Such a bare start that dies at the floor is still counted, which narrows the task's goal (item 1: 'a start that never reached make static costs the task none of its two static runs') to the T= form.
decisions.why: D11 requires counting a run under its own task and every run counting. Without a T=, a launch line could only be filed under the tree's guess, which the plan measured as another task's after 198 of 464 calls. That is the risk to another task's count, and the D11 narrowing, that the previous round BLOCKED. Leaving the bare form on D11's existing mechanism is the only form that keeps D11 whole: it can over-count a dead bare start but never moves another task's count or under-counts a real run. That errs toward FR-007's purpose (making `make static` stop being the edit loop) and has the recorded STATIC_OK escape. The defect left is also small: this task's floor fix removes the observed cause of dead starts (the cold-guard death) for every call form, bare calls included, so a bare dead start now needs the 600 s bound to run out. It is the accepted spec's own mechanism, not a departure from what the GM asked. One limitation: the plan says how many bare calls there are is not measured, so this ruling rests on the residual's rarity following from the floor fix, not on a count.

decisions.why: Presumed not legitimate and none of the three tests is met. Not impossible: the block itself names a strict-side rollout (mark own_t, or count by launch line, only where the tree's script writes that line) and rejects it for cost alone ('the guard reading the tree's script at every call'), which is the excluded reason. Not implied by the GM's words: the approval asks that 'all of the enforcement is real enforcement and not just instructions', and D11 says every run counts.
